title: GRIDLOCK: Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe – when every small step turns into something bold & beautiful
author: omni_debt5117
selftext:
My friend Ayush ([https://x.com/ACDNDSN](https://x.com/ACDNDSN)) has been quietly building this for years (the idea actually started back in 2017). He finally shipped it, and I wanted to share it on his behalf because it’s one of those rare games that feels simple at first glance… then completely redefines what you thought Tic-Tac-Toe could be. (Yes used ai for the whole indentations and Structuring so please bear with me for it, buit the wordings are mine.)

Honestly the whole story and the evulation of game is already in his X but here is me defining it in a simple way, keeping it short straight and comapct. Do tell whats your appreciation or improvisations to it.  
Gridlock takes the classic game and pushes it into 2–4 player territory with bigger boards, real strategy, and 11 special moves (Anchor, Push, Mirror, Nuke, Gravity, Bait… the list goes on). Every move still feels like placing a mark on paper, but those little decisions can completely reshape the board.

What really stands out is how the small things add up into something beautiful:

* The whole game is built around an ink-and-paper aesthetic – minimal, tactile, handcrafted animations that make every match feel alive.
* When the game ends, **CANVAS** turns your final board into a unique wallpaper you can actually keep and share.
* **ECHO** takes the entire sequence of moves and turns the match into its own song + short visual film. No two matches sound (or look) the same.

It’s local pass-and-play, online rooms, bots when friends are busy – pure strategy, not pay-to-win. Just thoughtful design layered on top of something everyone already understands.

He’s been building it solo (Flutter + a lot of care for the details), and the generative parts (wallpapers + the match-to-music/film system) are where the magic really shows what even the smallest game steps can become.

Free on the App Store:  
  
[https://apps.apple.com/in/app/gridlock-ultimate-tic-tac-toe/id6808733376](https://apps.apple.com/in/app/gridlock-ultimate-tic-tac-toe/id6808733376)

Would love to hear what you think if you give it a go. Especially curious how the special moves and ECHO land for people.

Place your mark. Break the pattern. Control the grid. (Global Matchmaking in the pipeline commign soon)
